description: This file provides inline helper functions for calculating resource indices within a PUCCH resource list, based on various resource IDs and configuration parameters.

methods.name: get_pucch_res_set_0_cell_res_idx
methods.description: Calculates the index of a Resource Set 0 resource in the cell PUCCH resource list based on resource set config ID and resource index.

methods.name: get_pucch_res_set_1_cell_res_idx
methods.description: Calculates the index of a Resource Set 1 resource in the cell PUCCH resource list based on resource set config ID and resource index.

methods.name: get_pucch_sr_cell_res_idx
methods.description: Calculates the index of a PUCCH resource for SR in the cell PUCCH resource list based on SR resource ID.

methods.name: get_pucch_csi_cell_res_idx
methods.description: Calculates the index of a PUCCH resource for CSI in the cell PUCCH resource list based on CSI resource ID.
